narrative.overview: NaijaOuting looks like a calm, well-kept guidebook laid over a busy city. The chrome stays quiet so the event flyers can carry the energy. One confident Naija green marks every action, marigold marks dates and time, and signal red is kept for live and warnings.
keyCharacteristics: Soft, short shadows on white over limestone
Light, dark, Ankara, Lagoon and High contrast modes

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Only Naija Green says 'do this'. Marigold is for time, red is for danger or live.

rules.name: The Flyer Is Loudest Rule
rules.body: The interface around flyers stays neutral so they never compete.

rules.name: The Weight Not Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and size inside Inter.

rules.name: The Short Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows lift paper off stone, never glow.

dos: Do keep Naija Green as the only action colour and give each screen one clear primary action.
Do show unknown details honestly ('Venue to be confirmed', 'See organiser') in Muted Ink rather than hiding the field.
Do keep flyers in square frames and let them be the most colourful thing on the screen.
Do check every change in light mode, dark mode and on a 390px-wide phone.
donts: Don't add coloured glow shadows; use the neutral shadow vocabulary.
Don't introduce new font families inside the app.
Don't show the NaijaOuting logo or wordmark until the owner asks for it back, and don't use third-party logos from the internet.
Don't show invented counts, testimonials, ratings or partner logos.
Don't let the landing page drift further from the app; bring the two dialects together when either is redesigned.
